response.overview: On May 7, 2005, the Corpus Brugge 05 cultural festival opened with an installation by Spencer Tunick. Tunick’s landscape art perfectly captured the festival’s theme: the body in art and culture. 2,000 people braved the cold and rain to bring this unique art project to life in Bruges. The installation was documented through video recordings and photography.
response.title: /spencer tunick in brugge
